why.bs: „Zar čovjek misli da kosti njegove nećemo sakupiti?” – spajanje dijelova.
why.en: “Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?” — bringing parts together.

why.bs: Onaj ko gomila imetak i prebrojava ga – جَمَعَ za imetak.
why.en: Who collects wealth and counts it — جَمَعَ for wealth.

why.bs: „Na Dan kada vas sakupi za Dan sakupljanja” – i جَمَعَ se kaže za Sudnji dan.
why.en: “The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly” — جَمَعَ is said of the Last Day too.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, izvesti skupinu ljudi s njihovog mjesta i potjerati ih (u boj i sl.), i kaže se samo za skupinu. U Kur'anu je najčešće sabiranje na Sudnjem danu; kaže se i za pojedinca (20:124–125).
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, to bring a group out of their place and drive them on (to battle and the like), said only of a group. In the Quran most often the mustering on the Day of Judgement; it is also said of a single person (20:124–125).

why.bs: Musa: „i neka se ljudi skupe u pretpodne” – okupljanje mnoštva na jedno mjesto.
why.en: Moses: “and that the people be gathered at mid-morning” — a multitude brought to one place.

why.bs: „Kad divlje životinje budu sabrane” – mnoštvo dovedeno na jedno mjesto.
why.en: “And when the wild beasts are gathered” — a multitude brought to one place.

why.bs: „Gospodaru moj, zašto si me slijepim oživio (حَشَرْتَنِي)?” – حَشَرَ za pojedinca, protivprimjer pravilu.
why.en: “My Lord, why have You raised me blind?” (حَشَرْتَنِي) — حَشَرَ of one person, a counter-example to the rule.

shared.bs: Oba glagola znače „uništiti”; razlikuju se po širini: propast u svakom obliku, ili potpuno zatiranje.
shared.en: Both verbs mean “to destroy”; they differ in breadth: perishing in any form, or utter destruction.

tellApart.bs: Uništiti, upropastiti – narode, ali i usjeve, imetak → أَهْلَكَ; zatrti, razoriti do temelja → دَمَّرَ.
tellApart.en: To destroy, cause to perish — peoples, but also crops and wealth → أَهْلَكَ; to wipe out, raze to the ground → دَمَّرَ.

sources: ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī, Mufradāt alfāẓ al-Qurʾān — entries هلك, دمر
notes: ar-Rāġib: halāk is used in several senses — loss of a thing, its corruption, death, and passing away altogether — attributed to him.

That دَمَّرَ is said in 7 of its 8 places of Allah's destruction of peoples and their works, and once of the wind 'by the command of its Lord' (46:25), and that its doubled form and the cognate accusative (17:16 tadmīran) stress completeness, is our observation, not a lexicographer's wording.
17:16 has both verbs: nuhlika then dammarnāhā.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

meaning.en: to destroy, to cause to perish

nuance.bs: Uništiti, dovesti do propasti. Najčešće o narodima koje je Allah uništio zbog njihovih grijeha, ali i o čovjeku koji upropaštava usjeve ili imetak.
nuance.en: To destroy, bring to ruin. Most often of peoples Allah destroyed for their sins, but also of a man who ruins crops or squanders wealth.

why.bs: „Zar ne vide koliko smo naroda prije njih uništili?”
why.en: “Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them?”

why.bs: Kad se okrene (ili: kad dođe na vlast – tefsir se razilazi), nastoji da uništi usjeve i porod – čovjek kao uzrok propasti.
why.en: When he turns away (or: gains authority — tafsir differs), he strives to destroy crops and offspring — a man as the cause of ruin.

why.bs: „Uludo sam potrošio silno blago” – أَهْلَكَ i za rasipanje imetka.
why.en: “I have squandered wealth in abundance” — أَهْلَكَ also of squandering wealth.

nuance.bs: Uništiti potpuno, ne ostaviti ništa. U Kur'anu (naše zapažanje) gotovo uvijek o Allahovom kažnjavanju naroda i njihovih djela; jednom o vjetru koji uništava „Gospodarevom voljom”.
nuance.en: To destroy completely, leaving nothing. In the Quran (our observation) almost always of Allah's punishment of peoples and their works; once of the wind that destroys “by command of its Lord”.

why.bs: Kad hoćemo da uništimo (نُهْلِكَ) neki grad… pa ga potpuno zatremo (دَمَّرْنَاهَا تَدْمِيرًا) – oba glagola, drugi kao vrhunac.
why.en: When We intend to destroy (نُهْلِكَ) a city… and We destroy it with complete destruction (دَمَّرْنَاهَا تَدْمِيرًا) — both verbs, the second as the climax.

why.bs: „I razorili smo ono što su faraon i njegov narod gradili” – zatiranje djela.
why.en: “We destroyed what Pharaoh and his people were producing” — wiping out works.

why.bs: Vjetar „koji će sve uništiti Gospodarevom voljom” – jedini subjekt koji nije Allah, a i on po Njegovoj naredbi.
why.en: A wind “destroying everything by command of its Lord” — the one subject other than Allah, and that by His command.

shared.bs: Oba glagola znače „steći, zaraditi” – i dobra i loša djela; razlikuju se po uloženom naporu i po tome za koga se stiče.
shared.en: Both verbs mean “to earn, to gain” — good deeds and bad; they differ in the effort involved and in for whom the gain is made.

tellApart.bs: Steći, zaraditi uopće – imetak, dobro ili zlo → كَسَبَ; steći za sebe (tefsir: s naporom) → اِكْتَسَبَ.
tellApart.en: To earn, gain in general — wealth, good or evil → كَسَبَ; to acquire for oneself (tafsir: with effort) → اِكْتَسَبَ.

sources: ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī, Mufradāt alfāẓ al-Qurʾān — entries كسب
notes: ar-Rāġib: kasb is what a person seeks to gain benefit and a share by; iktisāb is said only of what one gains for oneself, so every iktisāb is kasb but not every kasb is iktisāb; he cites 2:286 — attributed to him.

On 2:286 tafsir often explains why good is with kasabat and evil with iktasabat: the Form VIII stresses effort, and the soul strives harder after evil it desires. Given as the explanation of many mufassirun, not pinned to one; some treat the variation as stylistic only. 'Form VIII stresses effort' is theirs, not ar-Rāġib's (blind review).
4:32 (iktasabū / iktasabna, of men's and women's earnings) shows اِكْتَسَبَ used for what is not evil; so the 2:286 contrast is not a rule of the word.
اِكْتَسَبَ: 5 uses in 4 ayat.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, ono čime čovjek nastoji steći korist i udio. Opća riječ: zarađeni imetak, dobra djela i grijesi – sve što čovjek „zaradi”.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, what a person seeks to gain benefit and a share by. The general word: earned wealth, good deeds and sins — all that a person “earns”.

why.bs: „Njoj pripada ono što je zaradila (كَسَبَتْ), a na nju se odnosi ono što je stekla (اكْتَسَبَتْ)” – oba glagola.
why.en: “It will have what it has gained (كَسَبَتْ), and it will bear what it has earned (اكْتَسَبَتْ)” — both verbs.

why.bs: „Neće mu koristiti imetak njegov, ni ono što je stekao” – zarada, imetak.
why.en: “His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained” — earnings, wealth.

why.bs: „Onaj ko zlo zaradi” – كَسَبَ i za zlo.
why.en: “Whoever earns evil” — كَسَبَ for evil too.

meaning.en: to acquire, to earn for oneself

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, kaže se samo za ono što čovjek stiče za sebe. Mnogi mufessiri dodaju da oblik VIII podrazumijeva napor i time tumače 2:286, mada to ne prihvataju svi, a u 4:32 riječ je o dozvoljenoj zaradi muškaraca i žena.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, said only of what a person gains for himself. Many mufassirun add that Form VIII implies effort and explain 2:286 by it, though not all accept this, and 4:32 uses it for the lawful earnings of men and women.

why.bs: اكْتَسَبَتْ uz ono čime je duša opterećena – prema mnogim mufessirima: napor koji duša ulaže u ono što je privlači.
why.en: اكْتَسَبَتْ with what the soul bears — according to many mufassirun: the effort a soul spends on what draws it.

why.bs: Muškarcima pripada udio od onoga što zarade, i ženama od onoga što zarade – اِكْتَسَبَ bez ikakvog prizvuka zla.
why.en: For men is a share of what they have earned, and for women a share of what they have earned — اِكْتَسَبَ with no shade of evil.

why.bs: Svakom od njih – grijeh koji je stekao – اِكْتَسَبَ za lično stečen grijeh.
why.en: For every person among them is what he has earned of the sin — اِكْتَسَبَ for a sin acquired in person.

shared.bs: Obje riječi označavaju čovjeka u oskudici i obje su među primaocima zekata (9:60); učenjaci se razilaze ko je od njih u većoj nevolji.
shared.en: Both words denote a person in want and both are among the recipients of zakat (9:60); scholars differ over which of the two is in greater need.

tellApart.bs: Siromah, onaj ko je u potrebi – i čovjek u potrebi prema Allahu → فَقِير; nevoljnik, potrebit, najčešće uz siroče i putnika kao onaj koga treba nahraniti → مِسْكِين; ko je od njih u većoj nevolji, učenjaci se razilaze.
tellApart.en: The poor, one in need — and man in his need of Allah → فَقِير; the needy, most often named with the orphan and traveller as one to be fed → مِسْكِين; which is worse off, scholars differ.

sources: Tafsir and fiqh on 9:60 (e.g. al-Qurṭubī, al-Jāmiʿ li-aḥkām al-Qurʾān) — the views on faqīr and miskīn
notes: Scholars differ: in the Shāfiʿī view the faqīr is worse off (cf. 18:79, masākīn who own a boat); in the Ḥanafī view the miskīn is (cf. 90:16, miskīnan ḏā matraba, 'in the dust'). Both views and their proof ayat are given; neither is chosen.
That فَقِير is also said of man's need before Allah (35:15) and of Musa's prayer (28:24), while مِسْكِين is not used that way, is our observation of all places.
فَقِير includes the plural فُقَرَاء and مِسْكِين the plural مَسَاكِين: one lemma each in the corpus.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

nuance.bs: Onaj ko je u potrebi, kome nešto nedostaje. Kaže se i za čovjekovu potrebu prema Allahu: svi su ljudi „siromasi” pred Allahom, a Musa je za sebe rekao da je فَقِير dobra koje mu Allah spusti.
nuance.en: One in need, who lacks something. Said too of man's need of Allah: all people are “poor” before Allah, and Moses called himself فَقِير of whatever good Allah sends down.

why.bs: Zekat pripada siromasima (فُقَرَاء) i nevoljnicima (مَسَاكِين) – obje riječi, kao dvije skupine.
why.en: Zakat is for the poor (فُقَرَاء) and the needy (مَسَاكِين) — both words, as two groups.

why.bs: „O ljudi, vi ste Allahu potrebni, a Allah je Neovisni” – potreba svakog stvorenja.
why.en: “O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need” — the need of every creature.

why.bs: Siromasi koji ne dosađuju ljudima traženjem; zbog njihove suzdržanosti neupućeni ih smatraju bogatima.
why.en: The poor who do not ask people persistently; because of their restraint the ignorant think them self-sufficient.

nuance.bs: Potrebit, u oskudici; često se spominje uz siroče i putnika kao onaj kome treba dati hranu. Učenjaci se razilaze je li u većoj nevolji od فَقِير.
nuance.en: One in want; often named with the orphan and the traveller as one to be fed. Scholars differ on whether he is in greater need than the فَقِير.

why.bs: Lađa je pripadala nekim siromasima (مَسَاكِين) – imaju lađu, a ipak su مِسْكِين: dokaz onih koji kažu da je فَقِير u većoj nevolji.
why.en: The ship belonged to poor people (مَسَاكِين) — they own a ship yet are مِسْكِين: the proof of those who hold the faqīr worse off.

why.bs: „Ili nevoljnika bez igdje ičega” (ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ) – dokaz onih koji kažu da je مِسْكِين u većoj nevolji.
why.en: “Or a needy person in misery” (ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ) — the proof of those who hold the miskīn worse off.

why.bs: Onaj ko ne podstiče da se nahrani siromah – مِسْكِين kao onaj kome treba hrana.
why.en: Who does not encourage the feeding of the poor — the مِسْكِين as one who must be fed.

shared.bs: Obje riječi označavaju onoga ko je uz tebe i stoji za tebe; u Kur'anu često stoje jedna uz drugu, a razlikuju se po vrsti podrške.
shared.en: Both words denote one who is on your side and stands up for you; in the Quran they often stand together, and they differ in the kind of support.

tellApart.bs: Bliski zaštitnik, onaj ko se brine o tvojim poslovima, prijatelj, srodnik → وَلِيّ; pomagač koji pomaže protiv neprijatelja i daje pobjedu → نَصِير.
tellApart.en: A close protector, one who takes charge of your affairs, a friend, a kinsman → وَلِيّ; a helper who aids against an enemy and gives victory → نَصِير.

sources: ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī, Mufradāt alfāẓ al-Qurʾān — entries ولى, نصر
notes: ar-Rāġib: walāʾ is two or more things being so close that nothing comes between them, used of nearness in place, kinship, religion, friendship, help and belief — attributed to him.
That walī is the one who takes care of one's affairs and naṣīr the one who aids against an enemy is how tafsir often explains the pair; stated as such, not pinned to one mufassir.
That the two often stand together (2:107, 4:45, 9:116) is read from the ayat.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, od bliskosti u kojoj ništa ne stoji između dvoje. Zato وَلِيّ znači zaštitnika, prijatelja, saveznika i najbližeg srodnika – onoga ko preuzima brigu o tebi.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, from a nearness with nothing between the two. So وَلِيّ means protector, friend, ally and nearest kinsman — one who takes charge of you.

why.bs: „Allah je zaštitnik onih koji vjeruju; izvodi ih iz tmina na svjetlo” – Allahova briga o vjernicima.
why.en: “Allah is the ally of those who believe; He brings them out from darknesses into the light” — Allah's care for the believers.

why.bs: Ako neko bude ubijen nepravedno, njegovom bliskom srodniku (وَلِيّ), staratelju njegovog prava, dali smo vlast.
why.en: Whoever is killed unjustly — We have given his nearest kinsman (وَلِيّ), the guardian of his right, authority.

why.bs: „Mimo Allaha nemate zaštitnika ni pomagača” – وَلِيّ i نَصِير zajedno.
why.en: “You have not besides Allah any protector or any helper” — وَلِيّ and نَصِير together.

nuance.bs: Onaj ko pomaže i daje pobjedu (نَصْر) protiv neprijatelja ili nevolje. Često stoji odmah iza وَلِيّ ili مَوْلَى.
nuance.en: One who helps and gives victory (نَصْر) against an enemy or a hardship. It often comes right after وَلِيّ or مَوْلَى.

why.bs: „Allah je dovoljan zaštitnik i Allah je dovoljan pomagač.”
why.en: “Sufficient is Allah as an ally, and sufficient is Allah as a helper.”

why.bs: „Divan je On zaštitnik i divan pomagač!” – مَوْلَى i نَصِير.
why.en: “Excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper” — مَوْلَى and نَصِير.

why.bs: Isti ajet: zaštitnik koji se brine, pomagač koji brani.
why.en: The same ayah: a protector who takes care, a helper who defends.

shared.bs: Obje riječi znače sumnju; obično se razlikuju po tome je li to puko kolebanje između dvije mogućnosti ili sumnja praćena nemirom i nepovjerenjem.
shared.en: Both words mean doubt; they tend to differ in whether it is a bare wavering between two possibilities or doubt that brings unease and suspicion.

tellApart.bs: Kolebanje između dvije mogućnosti, bez prevage → شَكّ; sumnja s nemirom i nepovjerenjem – „nema sumnje u nju” → رَيْب.
tellApart.en: Wavering between two possibilities with no preponderance → شَكّ; doubt with unease and suspicion — “no doubt about it” → رَيْب.

sources: ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī, Mufradāt alfāẓ al-Qurʾān — entries شك
Tafsir on 2:2 — the sense of rayb
notes: ar-Rāġib: shakk is two opposites being equal in a person's mind, with no sign tipping towards either — attributed to him.
That rayb is doubt joined with unease and suspicion is how tafsir often explains it on 2:2; stated as such. ar-Rāġib's own wording on rayb is not used: it could not be checked word for word here.
The two meet in 11:62 and 34:54 (shakk … murīb), where murīb is from the root of rayb; cited under شَكّ.
52:30 rayb al-manūn: tafsir explains it as the accidents of time, or death; given as tafsir.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, stanje kada su dvije suprotne mogućnosti u čovjekovom umu jednake i nijedna ne preteže. Često se opisuje kao „sumnja koja uznemiruje” (مُرِيب).
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, the state in which two opposites are equal in the mind and neither tips the scale. Often described as a doubt “that disquiets” (مُرِيب).

why.bs: „Zar u Allaha ima sumnje, Stvoritelja nebesa i Zemlje?”
why.en: “Can there be doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth?”

why.bs: „Mi smo u sumnji koja uznemiruje” (شَكّ مُرِيب) – obje riječi: شَكّ i pridjev iz korijena رَيْب.
why.en: “We are in disquieting doubt” (شَكّ مُرِيب) — both: شَكّ and an adjective from the root of رَيْب.

why.bs: „Ako si u sumnji u ono što ti objavljujemo…” – uvjetna rečenica; prema većini mufessira ne podrazumijeva stvarnu sumnju kod Poslanika.
why.en: “If you are in doubt about what We have revealed to you…” — a conditional; most mufassirun hold it implies no actual doubt in the Prophet.

nuance.bs: Sumnja praćena nemirom i nepovjerenjem; tako je često tumači tefsir na početku sure el-Bekara. Kur'an njome kaže da u Knjigu i u Sudnji dan „nema sumnje”.
nuance.en: Doubt joined with unease and suspicion; so tafsir often explains it at the opening of al-Baqarah. The Quran uses it to say there is “no doubt” about the Book and the Last Day.

why.bs: „Ova Knjiga, u nju nema sumnje” – prvo što Kur'an kaže o sebi.
why.en: “This is the Book about which there is no doubt” — the first thing the Quran says of itself.

why.bs: „Ako sumnjate u proživljenje…” – رَيْب o ahiretu, a odmah zatim dokaz.
why.en: “If you should be in doubt about the Resurrection…” — رَيْب about the hereafter, followed at once by proof.

why.bs: „Čekamo da ga zadesi nesreća” (رَيْب الْمَنُون) – ovdje رَيْب znači nedaću, ne sumnju; tefsir: nedaće vremena ili smrt.
why.en: “We await for him misfortune of time” (رَيْب الْمَنُون) — here رَيْب means a calamity, not doubt; tafsir: the accidents of time, or death.

shared.bs: Sva tri glagola govore o opraštanju grijeha; razlikuju se po slici: prekrivanje i zaštita, brisanje i odustajanje od kazne, ili pokrivanje grijeha kao da nije učinjen.
shared.en: All three verbs speak of forgiving sins; they differ in the image: covering and shielding, erasing and forgoing the penalty, or covering the sin as though it were not done.

tellApart.bs: Oprostiti i zaštititi od kazne → غَفَرَ; preći preko, ne kazniti – Allahov oprost, a često i oprost među ljudima (u odmazdi, mehru, uvredi) → عَفَا; izbrisati, pokriti loša djela → كَفَّرَ.
tellApart.en: To forgive and shield from punishment → غَفَرَ; to pardon, let pass unpunished — Allah's pardon, and often pardon between people (in retaliation, bridal due, offence) → عَفَا; to remove, cover over bad deeds → كَفَّرَ.

sources: ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī, Mufradāt alfāẓ al-Qurʾān — entries غفر, عفا, كفر
notes: ar-Rāġib: ghafr is clothing a thing with what shields it from dirt (hence mighfar, the helmet); maghfira from Allah is His shielding the servant from punishment — attributed to him.
ar-Rāġib: takfīr of a sin is covering it until it is as if it had not been done — attributed to him.
That ʿafw is from ʿafā, 'to efface' (as wind effaces a trace) is a common explanation in tafsir; given as such. Which of maghfira and ʿafw is the greater is not decided here: tafsir differs.
The ordering in 2:286 (wa-ʿfu ʿannā wa-ghfir lanā) is cited as it stands, without a claim about why.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, osnovno značenje je prekriti onim što štiti (odatle مِغْفَر, kaciga); Allahov oprost je da roba zaštiti od kazne. Kaže se i za ljude koji praštaju.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, the root sense is covering with what shields (hence مِغْفَر, the helmet); Allah's forgiveness is shielding the servant from punishment. Said also of people who forgive.

why.bs: „Allah će sigurno sve grijehe oprostiti” – tefsir ga čita sa sljedećim ajetom: onima koji Mu se vrate (usp. 4:48).
why.en: “Allah forgives all sins” — tafsir reads it with the next ayah: for those who turn back to Him (cf. 4:48).

why.bs: Allah neće oprostiti da Mu se pridružuju druga božanstva (širk), a manje od toga oprostit će kome hoće.
why.en: Allah does not forgive association with Him, but forgives what is less than that for whom He wills.

why.bs: „Reci vjernicima neka oproste” – غَفَرَ među ljudima.
why.en: “Say to those who believe to forgive” — غَفَرَ between people.

nuance.bs: Preći preko grijeha, ne kazniti za njega; u tefsiru se veže za „brisanje” traga. Često o ljudima među sobom: oprost u odmazdi, u mehru, u uvredi.
nuance.en: To pass over a sin, to forgo its penalty; tafsir links it to “effacing” a trace. Often of people among themselves: pardon in retaliation, in the bridal due, in an offence.

why.bs: „Pređi preko naših grijeha, oprosti nam i smiluj nam se” – عَفَا i غَفَرَ jedno uz drugo.
why.en: “Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy upon us” — عَفَا and غَفَرَ side by side.

why.bs: „Neka oproste i neka preko toga pređu” – oprost među ljudima.
why.en: “Let them pardon and overlook” — pardon between people.

why.bs: Nesreće vas pogađaju zbog onoga što činite, a On mnogo prašta (يَعْفُو).
why.en: Disaster strikes you for what your hands have earned, but He pardons much (يَعْفُو).

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, pokriti grijeh dok ne postane kao da nije učinjen. Objekt su gotovo uvijek „loša djela” (سَيِّئَات); iz istog je korijena كَفَّارَة, iskup.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, covering a sin until it is as though it were not done. Its object is almost always “bad deeds” (سَيِّئَات); from the same root is كَفَّارَة, expiation.

why.bs: Ako se klonite velikih grijeha, izbrisat ćemo vam loša djela (prema većini mufessira: manje grijehe) – كَفَّرَ za loša djela.
why.en: If you avoid the major sins, We will remove from you your misdeeds (most mufassirun: the lesser sins) — كَفَّرَ for bad deeds.

why.bs: „Sigurno ću im izbrisati loša djela njihova i uvesti ih u dženetske bašče.”
why.en: “I will surely remove from them their misdeeds and admit them to gardens.”

why.bs: Iskreno pokajanje – nada da će Gospodar izbrisati loša djela.
why.en: Sincere repentance — the hope that your Lord will remove your misdeeds.

title.en: To repent and to turn back

shared.bs: Oba glagola znače vratiti se Allahu; razlikuju se po tome je li u prvom planu ostavljanje grijeha ili stalno okretanje Allahu srcem i djelom.
shared.en: Both verbs mean returning to Allah; they differ in whether leaving the sin or a constant turning to Allah in heart and deed is in view.

tellApart.bs: Pokajati se, ostaviti grijeh – i Allahovo primanje pokajanja (تَابَ عَلَى) → تَابَ; obraćati se Allahu, vraćati se Njemu iskreno, i bez spomena grijeha → أَنَابَ.
tellApart.en: To repent, leave the sin — and Allah's accepting it (تَابَ عَلَى) → تَابَ; to turn to Allah, return to Him sincerely, even with no sin in view → أَنَابَ.

sources: ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī, Mufradāt alfāẓ al-Qurʾān — entries توب, نوب
notes: ar-Rāġib: tawb is leaving a sin in the best way, the most eloquent form of apology; when Allah is said to tāba ʿalā someone, He accepts his repentance — attributed to him.
ar-Rāġib: ināba to Allah is returning to Him with repentance and sincerity of deed — attributed to him.
That أَنَابَ is never said of Allah in the Quran (all 11 uses have a human subject) while تَابَ is said of both, is our observation.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, ostaviti grijeh na najljepši način. Isti glagol se kaže i za Allaha – تَابَ عَلَيْهِ: primio je njegovo pokajanje, okrenuo mu se milošću.
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, leaving a sin in the finest way. The same verb is said of Allah — تَابَ عَلَيْهِ: He accepted his repentance, turned to him in mercy.

why.bs: „Zatim im je oprostio da bi se pokajali” – تَابَ za Allaha i za ljude u istom ajetu.
why.en: “Then He turned to them so they could repent” — تَابَ of Allah and of people in one ayah.

why.bs: Adem je primio riječi od Gospodara, pa mu je On oprostio – Allahovo primanje pokajanja.
why.en: Adam received words from his Lord, and He accepted his repentance.

why.bs: Ko se pokaje i čini dobro, on se Allahu istinski vraća – pokajanje uz dobro djelo.
why.en: Whoever repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with a true turning — repentance with good deeds.

nuance.bs: Prema ar-Rāġibu, vraćanje Allahu pokajanjem i iskrenim djelom. Kaže se i bez spomena grijeha – kao stalno okretanje Allahu; nikad za Allaha (naše zapažanje).
nuance.en: According to ar-Rāġib, returning to Allah with repentance and sincere deeds. Said also with no sin in view — as a constant turning to Allah; never of Allah (our observation).

why.bs: Davud je pao ničice i Allahu se obratio – vraćanje poslije iskušenja.
why.en: David fell down bowing and turned in repentance — returning after a trial.

why.bs: „Obratite se Gospodaru svome i pokorite Mu se prije nego što vam dođe kazna.”
why.en: “Return to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you.”

why.bs: Šuajb: „Samo se na Njega oslanjam i samo Njemu se obraćam” – okretanje Allahu bez spomena grijeha.
why.en: Shuʿayb: “Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return” — turning to Allah with no sin in view.

shared.bs: Obje riječi se mogu prevesti s „otac”; razlikuju se po tome je li u prvom planu očinstvo u širem smislu ili rađanje.
shared.en: Both words can be rendered “father”; they differ in whether fatherhood in a wider sense or begetting is in view.

tellApart.bs: Otac, i djed, predak, pa i amidža – očevi kao predaja koja se slijedi → أَب; roditelj koji je rodio, najčešće „oba roditelja” kojima se čini dobro → وَالِد.
tellApart.en: Father, also grandfather, forefather, even an uncle — the fathers as a tradition followed → أَب; the parent who begot, most often “both parents” to be treated well → وَالِد.

sources: ar-Rāġib al-Iṣfahānī, Mufradāt alfāẓ al-Qurʾān — entries أب, ولد
notes: ar-Rāġib: ab is the father, and anyone who is a cause of bringing a thing into being, reforming it or making it appear is called ab; the uncle is called ab with the father, citing 2:133 where Ismāʿīl is counted among Yaʿqūb's fathers though he was his uncle — attributed to him.
أَب: the corpus files the broken plural آبَاء (64) and the dual أَبَوَان (7) separately; counted together with أَب (46): 117.
وَالِد: the corpus files the dual with suffix (وَالِدَيْهِ, 10) as a lemma of its own beside وَالِد (14); counted together: 24.
12:100 abawayhi: tafsir differs on whether this is his father and mother (if she was still alive) or his father and maternal aunt; stated so.
90:3 wa-wālidin wa-mā walad: tafsir differs (Ādam and his offspring, or every begetter and what he begets); stated so.
al-ʿAskarī's al-Furūq is not used: its wording on this pair could not be verified here.

nuance.bs: Otac; prema ar-Rāġibu, i svako ko je uzrok nastanka ili popravka nečega – djed, predak, pa i amidža. U množini (آبَاء) često „preci” čiju predaju ljudi slijede.
nuance.en: Father; according to ar-Rāġib, also anyone who is a cause of a thing's coming to be or its betterment — a grandfather, a forefather, even an uncle. In the plural (آبَاء) often the “forefathers” whose way people follow.

why.bs: „Tvome Bogu i Bogu tvojih predaka Ibrahima, Ismaila i Ishaka” – Ismail, Jakubov amidža, među „očevima”.
why.en: “Your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac” — Ishmael, Jacob's uncle, among the “fathers”.

why.bs: „Slijedit ćemo ono na čemu smo zatekli pretke svoje” – آبَاء kao predaja.
why.en: “We will follow that which we found our fathers doing” — آبَاء as tradition.

why.bs: Jusuf je roditelje (أَبَوَيْهِ) popeo na prijesto – tefsir se razilazi: otac i majka, ili otac i tetka (majčina sestra).
why.en: Joseph raised his parents (أَبَوَيْهِ) upon the throne — tafsir differs: father and mother, or father and maternal aunt.

nuance.bs: Onaj koji je rodio – riječ iz glagola وَلَدَ, „roditi”. Najčešće u dvojini, „oba roditelja”, u naredbi da im se čini dobro i u propisima o nasljedstvu.
nuance.en: The one who begot — from the verb وَلَدَ, “to beget”. Most often in the dual, “both parents”, in the command to treat them well and in the laws of inheritance.

why.bs: „I da roditeljima dobročinstvo činite” – وَالِدَيْن uz zapovijed da se samo Allahu ibadet čini.
why.en: “And to parents, good treatment” — وَالِدَيْن beside the command to worship none but Allah.

why.bs: Dan kada roditelj neće moći pomoći djetetu svome – وَالِد i وَلَد, rađanje u prvom planu.
why.en: A Day when no parent will avail his child — وَالِد and وَلَد, begetting in view.

why.bs: Naložili smo čovjeku da roditeljima dobro čini; majka ga je s mukom nosila i s mukom rodila.
why.en: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents; his mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship.
